name: FNM S.p.A.
summary: FNM S.p.A. engages in the sustainable mobility solutions in Italy. The company operates through the Freeways, Railway Infrastructure, Energy, RO.S.CO., and Mobility and Services segments. The company is involved in the design, construction, and management of motorways and the ring roads, terminal management activity, the renewable energy business, the development of new plants, the rental of rolling stock with an owned fleet in the public transport and freight transport sector, the sale of tickets, subcontracting activities, and car-sharing business.
